messages:
Maya: Hi team — kicking off the starter handshake with Lumina Labs. Goal: align stakeholders, define success criteria, and lock a rough 30/60/90 timeline. Quick replies please.
Jordan: Thanks Maya. Who from Lumina will own infra/network? we need VPN & firewall notes earlier.
Liam: Hey all, Liam here (Lumina). I'll be the primary contact for product + infra. VPN is handled by Nora on our side.
Maya: Perfect — @Liam noted. Can you confirm Nora's email and preferred meeting hours (PST/EST)?
Liam: nora@lumina.com, prefers mornings PST.
Priya: From eng side: we need sample traffic, model size, and SSO config. If they plan to pin model versions, tell us which ones.
Maya: Action items: (1) Lumina shares sample API calls + expected qps, (2) Security contacts + SSO metadata, (3) success criteria list. I'll draft a one-pager.
Jordan: For timeline, propose: week 0: discovery & creds, week 1-2: integration + test traffic, week 3: performance tuning + canary, week 4: handoff/enablement. Good?
Liam: That looks reasonable. Can we move canary to week 2 if infra clears?
Priya: We can compress to 2 weeks if sample traffic is representative and they enable prefix caching. Need their token policy too.
Maya: Noted. Probable plan: 2-week fast path (compressed) or 4-week standard. Lumina to confirm preference.
OnboardBot: Reminder — please fill the onboarding intake form: /onboard fill lumina-labs. Deadline: 3 business days. :spiral_calendar:
Liam: Filled the form, flagged VPN cert step as blocker — sending certs to secure dropbox.
Maya: Thanks. I'll schedule the discovery call tomorrow 10am PST. Invite shortly. Any other stakeholders to add?
Jordan: Add Security (Tess) and Platform (Ravi) on invite.
Priya: Also add SRE (Alicia) for latency SLO discussion.
Liam: Added Nora and Tess. Looking forward.
Maya: Great. Success criteria draft (very rough): 1) End-to-end request latency < 300ms p95 for 2k qps *or* aligned throughput target, 2) Authenticated API access + audit logging, 3) Model output quality within baseline eval (we'll share eval prompts), 4) Runbook + handoff docs published. Please suggest edits.
Jordan: Add rollback/fallback policy to SLOs (which model variant we fallback to).
Priya: Add quantization/checkpoint we plan to use. Also need their dataset HTP for privacy checks.
Liam: Ok on rollback. We'll share eval prompts & HTP by EOD.
Maya: Excellent — next steps: discovery call invite, intake form done, Lumina to send certs + eval prompts. I will circulate the one-pager and 30/60/90 options post-call. Closing here until the meeting — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
